narrative:

Mean daily demand is 343.49 units with standard deviation 194.92 units.

Lead time is volatile (mean=1.36 days, CV=0.81), with lead_time_variability being the dominant 
source of uncertainty (73.6% of total variance).

Recommended safety stock of 728 units provides 95% service level protection, equivalent to 
2.12 days of demand coverage. This represents a DECREASE from the current SAP safety lead time 
of 4.5 days.

The optimized order quantity of 5857 units (vs MOQ of 2228) balances ordering costs against holding costs, 
yielding annual savings of $562.04 compared to current SAP policy.
